'''The Spike''' was a modular [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. It was used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] as a mobile manufacturing center. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], it was [[Raid on The Spike|raided]] by [[Daimanate]] forces and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] while above [[Chelloa]].
